description: Attach an existing course rubric to an assignment, so one rubric can be shared across many assignments instead of creating a duplicate per assignment with create_rubric. Returns the new rubric association.

assignment_id.description: The Canvas assignment ID to attach the rubric to

hide_score_total.description: Whether to hide the rubric score total from students

rubric_id.description: The ID of the existing rubric to attach

use_for_grading.description: Whether the rubric drives the assignment grade

name: attach_rubric
title: Attach Rubric
